text:
St. John Fisher University Catholic Parish announces leadership transition and upcoming events
St. John Fisher University Catholic Parish released its latest newsletter on June 19, outlining leadership changes, upcoming events, and community updates for parishioners in Auburn Hills.
Fr. Matthew Hood announced his upcoming departure from St. John Fisher as he prepares to begin his new assignment as Director of Priestly Vocations for the Archdiocese, in addition to his previous role with Detroit Catholic Campus Ministry. In his message, Fr. Hood said, “I am now preparing for the transition here at St. John Fisher, where I will be leaving and I will begin my new assignment as the Director of Priestly Vocations for the Archdiocese along with my previous assignment with Detroit Catholic Campus Ministry. Before my official goodbyes, I want to first offer my gratitude for this past year. This has been a year that has not been easy for many reasons. However, even with the difficulties, I am grateful for the opportunity to be able to serve here and to try to help and lead this parish. I am especially grateful to our wonderful parish staff for their support over this past year. Their love for the Lord, the mission of St. John Fisher, and our parishioners and students has been an inspiration to me and has greatly helped me in my ministry. I am confident that their ongoing support will be a tremendous benefit to Fr. Drew as he begins his assignment. I am also grateful to each of you. Your welcome, community, and hospitality have demonstrated the love of God to me. Thank you! Please also remember to continue to pray for a new outpouring of priestly vocations in the Archdiocese. I believe there are many reasons to hope that this is possible not least of which is the power of God’s grace. Thank you! God bless, Fr. Matt.”
The parish announced updates to its Mass schedule, including the addition of a Tuesday Mass at 12:05 PM starting July 7. Saturday morning Mass and confessions will be cancelled on July 4 due to the holiday. Parishioners are invited to attend the St. John Fisher Feast Day Mass and Celebration on June 22 at 7:15 PM, with food and ice cream to follow.
The newsletter also addressed the Archdiocese of Detroit’s ongoing restructuring process. Listening sessions for the region have concluded, and materials from those sessions are now available online. Parishioners are encouraged to review the proposed models for St. John Fisher’s region and submit feedback through an anonymous online survey by July 31, 2026.
Additional events include Vacation Bible School registration, a Eucharistic Revival event in Detroit, and several community gatherings such as the Young Sacristans Program, Grizzly Catholic Community Dinner, Young Adult Dinner and Fellowship, Grizzly Catholic Men’s Camping Trip, and a farewell party for Fr. Hood on June 28. A welcome celebration for Fr. Drew Mabee is scheduled for July 19, and the parish picnic will take place on September 27.
St. John Fisher Parish is located at 3665 E. Walton Blvd., Auburn Hills. More information, including Mass schedules and event details, can be found at www.GrizzlyCatholic.org.
